text:
Rae: Quick heads-up before we go live — we need to swap the customer spotlight and roadmap order. Demo should stay last. This will shift slide timings by ~40s. Can ops confirm recorder continuity?
Jun: On it. Patching the deck now and will push new timestamps into the MC notes. ETA 35s.
Priya: Saw a 30s gap in the rehearsal recorder when scene changed. Spinning up a rolling fallback recorder and switching OBS ingest to standby.
EngOps: ingest switched to standby-node-8 :white_check_mark:
Priya: Kickoff command for fallback:
```
recorderctl start --session ah-3301 --out /mnt/recs/allhands-3301-fallback.mp4 --mode rolling --fallback standby-node-8
```
RecorderBot: Fallback recorder started: /mnt/recs/allhands-3301-fallback.mp4 (id: rb-3301)
Rae: Nice. Also add a 20s buffer after roadmap for captions to resync — last run drifted when presenters overlapped.
Jun: Done. Slide 1 note: "Roadmap -> +20s buffer -> Customer Spotlight -> Demo". Deck uploaded: https://drive.internal/decks/allhands-3301-v2.pptx
Priya: Encoder looks stable on standby, no frame drops in the last 3m. Keeping fallback until upload completes.
Rae: For Q&A, prioritize pricing (monthly vs annual commit flexibility), Dedicated autoscaler timeline, and onboarding for Private deployments. We'll take top 4.
Mia (CEO): Good call. We'll mark the autoscaler as "planned (Q2 design)" on the roadmap slide and reserve 7 minutes for pricing/commit questions right after the roadmap. @Product pls have a PM on standby for details.
EngOps: INF-999 created to track raw recording + trimmed clip upload. Attachments to follow.
Jun: Who's moderating the Q&A? I can surface the top 4 to Mia but need someone to triage the live queue.
Rae: I'll moderate. Jun — highlight pricing Qs and pin them for priority.
Priya: Running a quick caption resync now (will trigger ~10s before go).
Priya: caption-resync triggered :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jun: Feed looks clean. Captions re-synced.
RecorderBot: Upload queued: will attach to INF-999 after session.
Rae: Post-meeting tasks: Priya attach raw recording + INF-999, Jun export a 10m highlight for comms, Product to send pricing FAQ doc, Rae to send prioritized Q list to Mia.
Mia (CEO): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick ops response. We'll call out the reorder in the intro and be explicit about autoscaler status.
Rae: OK moving to live. If anyone sees audio or frame issues, ping this thread and I'll cut to backup. Good luck :slightly_smiling_face:
Priya: Seeing stable feed now. Starting recorder watch.
Jun: Deck slide timers updated, presenters notified.
RecorderBot: Upload complete: https://internal-storage/recs/allhands-3301-fallback.mp4 :rocket:
Rae: Great. Closing thread and monitoring live. Backchannel if anything pops up.
